items.name: CRT Scanlines
items.description: Old tube: dark bands between phosphor rows, a horizontal wobble that drifts, and a vignette. Visible on a flat colour.

items.name: RGB Split
items.description: Chromatic aberration: red and blue are pulled apart towards the edges while the centre stays sharp, with a soft vignette. Needs texture detail to show -- on a flat colour it is invisible.
